name: Steak with Blistered Tomatoes, Roasted Garlic, Lemony Yogurt & Parsley
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place tomatoes and whole (unpeeled) garlic cloves on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with sugar and spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring tomatoes halfway through, until they start to burst, 13-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate and set aside to rest.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into a medium bowl; add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the lemony yogurt and set aside.
Once the tomatoes have begun to burst, change the oven to broil on high. Broil until tomatoes are lightly charred, about 3 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the tomatoes are done, carefully transfer roasted garlic to the cutting board. Using the back of a spoon, press on the cloves to remove the skins. Return garlic to the baking sheet.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and chop the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the baking sheet with the tomatoes and garlic; toss to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and lemony yogurt between plates. Top yogurt with roasted tomatoes, garlic, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
